card.name: Small words after a comma before an instruction
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "and" or "carefully" that come right after a clause or comma and begin an instruction, mostly in hypersensitivity warnings and preparation steps.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity warning
modes.description: The word "the" after "If such signs or symptoms are present," before "patient should be evaluated".
modes.example: of hypersensitivity, such as fever or lymphadenopathy, may be present even though rash is not evident. If such signs or symptoms are present,<< the>> patient should be evaluated immediately. Pheny

modes.label: "and" joining action steps
modes.description: The word "and" linking two instructed actions, such as shaking and releasing, or discontinuing and evaluating.
modes.example: icasone propionate nasal spray before using for the first time or after a period of non-use (1 week or more) by shaking the contents well<< and>> releasing 6 sprays into the air

modes.label: Patent claim wording
modes.description: The word "product" inside a computer program claim.
